claimText: Japan hosted the 2020 Summer Olympics in 2021 due to COVID-19 delay

brave.title: Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games held in 2021 due to pandemic postponement
brave.description: The Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games were held from 23 July to 8 August 2021, postponed by one year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The Games retained the 'Tokyo 2020' name.

brave.title: IOC: Tokyo 2020 Games postponed to 2021 due to COVID-19
brave.description: The International Olympic Committee and the Tokyo 2020 Organising Committee jointly announced the postponement of the Olympic Games to 2021 due to the global pandemic.

brave.title: BBC: Tokyo Olympics 2020 — how the postponed Games unfolded
brave.description: The Tokyo 2020 Olympics, delayed by a year due to COVID-19, took place in summer 2021 with strict health protocols and mostly empty stadiums.

brave.title: AP News: Japan successfully hosts delayed 2020 Olympics amid pandemic
brave.description: Japan hosted the 2020 Summer Olympics in July-August 2021, the first Games ever postponed in peacetime. The event was held largely without spectators.
